notes.keyDerivation: Raw ML-KEM-768 keygen with the listed 64-byte seeds; no SDK HKDF derivation.
notes.memberKeyBinding: Advertised {claim, kem, publicKey} entries are committed by memberKeysHash.
notes.keySig: keySig and stale-key verification are specified but out of scope; verification step 2 is skipped because it needs the DACS signer.
notes.contentHash: SHA-256 over UTF8(JCS(header)) || iv || ciphertext || tag.
